source_text.body:
Turn a grocery list photo into a route-ordered todo list
A commenter has Claude convert a photo of a blackboard grocery list into a phone todo list ordered by an efficient route through the store, using the taught store layout.
·
Sep 11, 2026
Done with
CL
Claude
What they did
They write the household shopping list on a blackboard, snap a photo, and send it to Claude, which turns it into a phone todo list with emojis and reorders the items for the walk through their local supermarket. The person had to teach Claude the store once by giving a logical item order for the small store’s fixed entrance-to-exit path, including rules like produce first, frozen last, and heavy items before delicate ones.
How it went
The result is a list ordered to match their store route rather than a generic grocery list. The source gives no time or accuracy numbers, and it depends on a one-time manual setup because no public store map was available.
Worth knowing
The key catch is that they had to train it manually once, but only because the store is small and follows a mostly predefined path.
Try it yourself
with
Claude
Copy prompt
Here's a photo of my handwritten grocery list. Turn it into a checklist I can paste into my phone's todo app, ordered as an efficient walking route through [store name]. The store layout is: [aisle order or section descriptions]. Group items by section, flag anything you couldn't read, and ask me about unclear items before finalizing the list.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1w2jtq8/whats_the_dumbest_thing_you_use_ai_for
